summary: Radiopharm Theranostics Limited filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered offering of 1,281,646 ADSs (representing 384,493,800 ordinary shares) at $3.16 per ADS, with gross proceeds of ~$4.05 million. A concurrent private placement includes warrants to purchase up to 1,281,646 ADSs at $3.79 per ADS, expiring July 31, 2029. H.C. Wainwright acts as placement agent receiving 7% cash fee and placement agent warrants. This is an ordinary capital-raising transaction, not a special-situation event. Watch for shareholder approval effectiveness and warrant exercise overhang.
